notes.title: Beta Update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Beta 1.0.4 Update Patch notes;

 Fixed server side connection issue.
 Fixed client connection UI able to connect while starting a party.
 Fixed UI issues.
 Changed Main Menu background.
 Fixed up Spas 12 Icon.
 Made Spas 12 bullet spray 8 from its original 10.
 Fixed Spas 12 spawning with 8 ammo, instead of 6.
 Adjusted lighting in main menu.
 Fixed Appeal code issues.
 Fixed anti cheat issue with code injecting.
 Added dead player chat.
 Made how to play button larger to encourage reading it.
 Fixed party matching delay.
 Fixed gun particle not spawning on full auto.
 Changed falloff range for Spas 12.
 Made silenced sounds quieter, but extended their falloff range
 Fixed time out kick reason.
 Changed allowed shadow depth so that shadows can no longer be fully turned off.
 Fixed airdrop spawning above ground.
 Fixed reloading bug.
 Fixed server side spectating.
 Set client side spectating to auto update.


     The update should release a couple of hours after this announcement, if not you can see why or ask a question in the discord server here - https://discord.gg/yrSxGbZ and I appreciate the support thanks for playing, -BiTz
